changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Delete the legacy actions_config rows seeded by actions-data.sql for actions that have no JSON action config in grants-config-land-grants. db.changelog-1.89 copied their legacy enabled flag into the config, so some (e.g. SPM4) were still treated as enabled actions, making SUPBAS base actions such as UPL1 report hasSupplements = true. The actions rows are kept: they are owned by the actions_eligibility.csv ingest. An explicit list is used so that actions ingested from grants-config are never removed.
